versions.changelog:
fabrica-design-md 1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for extracting and documenting brand design systems in DESIGN.md format.
- Extracts visual identity from existing code, images, or via interview—never invents or copies from other brands.
- Measures real color usage by frequency from code or visuals; contrast ratios are always measured by script, not estimated.
- Guides users to provide their 9 most effective pieces based on audience engagement—not just personal preference.
- Includes clear steps for identifying brand “signature”, documenting usage rules, and handling exceptions.
- Designed to run on OpenClaw (server + Telegram), with special instructions for working with uploads and server-side scripts.
